description: This is a PHPUnit test class for the LocationDao class, testing various data retrieval methods related to Location entities within the OrangeHRM system, specifically for the Admin plugin.

classes.name: LocationDaoTest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for testing LocationDao methods, ensuring that location data retrieval functions work correctly within the OrangeHRM Admin plugin context.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes the LocationDao instance and sets up test fixtures before each test.

methods.name: testGetLocationById
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Location entity by its ID and verifies correct data is returned.

methods.name: testGetLocationByIdForNonExistingId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of a Location entity with a non-existing ID to ensure null is returned.

methods.name: testGetNumberOfEmployeesForLocation
methods.description: Tests the retrieval of the number of employees associated with a specific Location.

methods.name: testGetLocationList
methods.description: Tests that the list of Location IDs contains the expected number of entries.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForNullArray
methods.description: Tests searching locations with default parameters (no filters), expecting all locations.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForLocationName
methods.description: Tests searching locations filtered by name.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCity
methods.description: Tests searching locations filtered by city.

methods.name: testSearchLocationsForCountry
methods.description: Tests searching locations filtered by country code.

methods.name: testGetSearchLocationListCount
methods.description: Verifies the count of search results filtered by country code.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployees
methods.description: Tests retrieval of location IDs based on a list of employee numbers.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesOneEmployee
methods.description: Tests location ID retrieval for a single employee.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesNoEmployees
methods.description: Checks that no location IDs are returned when given an empty employee list.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesEmployeesWithoutLocations
methods.description: Checks the case where employees do not have associated location data.

methods.name: testGetLocationIdsForEmployeesInvalidEmployees
methods.description: Ensures empty result for invalid employee IDs.

methods.name: testGetLocationsByIds
methods.description: Tests fetching Location objects by a set of IDs.
